Definition: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go through, flee, run away, chase, drive away, put to flight, reach, shoot (extend), hurry away; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go, pass through; 1a2) to flee; 1a3) to hasten, come quickly; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to pass through; 1b2) to cause to flee, put to flight; 1b3) to drive away
